stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: Postgres connection pool exhaustion
stub_knowledge.chunk: Symptoms: HikariCP 'connection is not available, request timed out' and Postgres 'sorry, too many clients already'. Check pool size vs active connections and pg_stat_activity for idle-in-transaction sessions holding connections. Common causes: connection leaks (unreturned checkouts), long-running transactions, or a traffic spike beyond pool capacity. A human should identify leaking code paths or tune pool/max_connections.

stub_knowledge.title: Postmortem 2026-03: settlement worker connection leak
stub_knowledge.chunk: Historical incident: settlement-worker leaked connections inside a batch loop, exhausting the shared Postgres (198/200 connections) and starving payment-api. Signature: HikariCP timeout errors plus pg_stat_activity dominated by one service.

useful_rubric_notes: Useful when the draft identifies pool exhaustion (not generic latency) and cites the pool runbook or historical leak postmortem.
